description: cnb:clef-size-semitones 8 on the default sps-2 staff = 4 staff-spaces = 4/3 of the legacy 3-staff-space height. The dozenal display's two text anchors are separated horizontally by the scaled left-digit width, so the harvested bbox width scales linearly with the size setting: default renders w = 1.102 (tests/c-major-scale.json harvest, identical staff/config), so 8 semitones must render w = 1.102 * 4/3 = 1.469. The bbox HEIGHT is just the fixed 0.5 digit-anchor offset (text elements harvest as anchors, not glyph outlines) and is deliberately not asserted.

assertions.description: The dozenal clef is engraved in measure 1

assertions.description: 8 semitones = 4/3 of the default: bbox width 1.102 * 4/3 = 1.469
